name: cowart
description: A native tldraw canvas for Codex. cowart-open-canvas is Cowart's primary entry skill: whenever Cowart is invoked, load cowart_mcp and make render_cowart_canvas_widget available before any other Cowart work.

interface.shortDescription: Open Cowart's native canvas first, then create, annotate, and generate in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Cowart brings a tldraw-powered native widget canvas into Codex for visual planning and creative iteration. cowart-open-canvas is the primary entry skill for every Cowart workflow: whenever the user invokes Cowart or any Cowart skill, Codex must first ensure cowart_mcp is loaded, make render_cowart_canvas_widget available, and open or refresh the project-backed native canvas before continuing. Users can then sketch ideas, place AI image holders, generate images into selected slots, and turn annotated screenshots into revised image outputs while keeping canvas data in the user's project workspace.
defaultPrompt: Open the Cowart canvas for this project.
Use my Cowart annotation screenshot to generate a clean revised image beside the original.
Generate a new image into the selected Cowart AI image holder.
